LESSON: WATER POLLUTION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter 2.1 Mixtures (14 Lessons) • Meaning of mixtures • Types of mixtures (hete
Topic 2.2: Water Pollution
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Water Pollution, part of Matter 2.1 Mixtures (14 Lessons) • Meaning of mixtures • Types of mixtures (hete in Grade 5 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: What are the dangers of water pollution?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on water pollutants in water sources,

2. discuss with peers the effects of water pollution in day-to-day life,

3. discuss with peers the different methods of reducing water pollution,

4. observe safety measures

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on water pollutants in water sources,
2. discuss with peers the effects of water pollution in day-to-day life,
3. discuss with peers the different methods of reducing water pollution,
4. observe safety measures

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Water Pollution together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: The learner reflects and comes up with new ideas in making functional water filters using locally

available materials.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner practices being responsible in playing different role as they carry out activities to demonstrate

methods of water treatment

• Peace: The learner learns how to share available materials amicably as they carry out activities to demonstrate methods of water

treatment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health Issues: The learner practices health preventive measures on water born diseases as they carry out activities to demonstrate

basic methods of water treatment.

Link to other Learning areas:

Agriculture and Nutrition: knowledge and skills on ways of reducing pollutants are used to obtain clean water for domestic use

in Agriculture and Nutrition.
